testcase.name: a forged entry whose envelope names another tenant is rejected and never returned()
invalidating a data source drops all its queries but not other data sources or tenants()
bypass is limited to the failing scope and expires()
canonical parameters ignore order and number formatting but not values()
invalidating one query leaves its siblings()
a backend outage on read or write is a miss never an error()
tenants never share an entry even with identical ids and parameters()
ttl is honoured per entry and zero is never stored()
every part of the key matters()
the in memory backend is bounded in entries and bytes()
a failed invalidation bypasses the scope so nothing stale is served()
the redis adapter obeys the same contract()
